name: KY-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Morgan McGarvey running with $1.8M cash on hand
Challenger Maria Rodriquez has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McGarvey: a Democratic-leaning Louisville seat, an incumbent with a large financial advantage, and an underfunded challenger. Markets agree, pricing his win odds near 95%.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race or a surge of outside spending for Rodriquez would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kentucky's 3rd District, anchored in Louisville, leans Democratic by about 10 points. Incumbent Morgan McGarvey is seeking reelection and has raised over $1.6 million with $1.8 million on hand. Republican challenger Maria Rodriquez reports no fundraising figures, leaving her at a steep resource disadvantage.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's financial edge, and prediction markets, which price McGarvey's chances at roughly 95%. The combination of a favorable seat, incumbency, and money makes McGarvey a strong favorite, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty.
